takes.sourceDescription: walk, shake hands (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Approach and handshake, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B walks forward, pauses with a hand extended for a handshake, then turns and walks away.

takes.sourceDescription: walk, shake hands (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Approach and handshake, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B takes a few steps, turns sideways and extends a hand for a handshake, then lowers the hand and settles.

takes.sourceDescription: A pulls B; B resists (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Resist a pull, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B extends one arm, leans away into a wide bent-knee stance and steps while maintaining the extended arm.

takes.sourceDescription: A pulls B; B resists (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Resist a pull, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B starts with an arm extended, shifts weight back into a low leaning stance, and steps while keeping the arm out.

takes.sourceDescription: A pulls B by the elbow; B resists (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Resist an elbow pull, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B starts standing, tilts sideways and takes small uneven steps while keeping one arm near the hip.

takes.sourceDescription: A pulls B by the elbow; B resists (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Resist an elbow pull, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B starts upright, spreads the arms and leans sideways into a low bent-knee stance, then continues stepping in that stance.

takes.sourceDescription: navigate busy sidewalk; A leads the way, takes B by the arm (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Follow through a sidewalk, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B takes walking steps, shifts sideways with a lean, then continues stepping with arms low.

takes.sourceDescription: conversation - explain with hand gestures (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Explain with hand gestures, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B stands and repeatedly gestures near the face and chest, raises both arms and sweeps them outward, then lowers them.

takes.sourceDescription: conversation - explain with hand gestures, walk (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Gesture while stepping, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B starts with head lowered, takes small steps, then raises the hands near the chest and face in conversational gestures.

takes.sourceDescription: quarrel - angry hand gestures (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Quarrel gestures, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B takes steps while repeatedly raising and spreading the hands, turns, lifts both arms and finally lowers them while looking down.

takes.sourceDescription: quarrel - angry hand gestures (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Quarrel and turning gestures, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B raises the hands near the face, gestures outward while stepping and turning, then lowers the arms and stands side-on.

takes.sourceDescription: friends meet, hang out; A sits, B joins A (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Join a seated friend, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B approaches, bends and lowers into a seated posture, gestures while seated, then leans forward and begins to rise.

takes.sourceDescription: run, scramble for last seat (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Scramble to a seat, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B moves into a wide low stance, shifts sideways and lowers into a seated position, remaining seated at the end.

takes.sourceDescription: run, scramble for last seat (2 subjects - subject B)
takes.title: Scramble for a seat, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B takes quick low steps, spreads the feet in a deep crouch, then rises and steps away.

takes.title: Chicken dance, participant B
takes.actionDescription: Participant B makes bent-arm gestures near the chest, repeats deep knee bends and crouches, and returns upright with hands together.
